facts.fact: Appropriate user modeling is addressed to generate cooperative responses to each user in spoken dialogue systems.
facts.supporting_span: We address appropriate user modeling in order to generate cooperative responses to each user in spoken dialogue systems .

facts.fact: The proposed user model is more comprehensive than previous studies.
facts.supporting_span: Unlike previous studies that focus on user 's knowledge or typical kinds of users , the user model we propose is more comprehensive .
